episode.tagline: Complex AI. Explained visually. Built practically.
episode.title: What Is an AI Agent?
episode.disclosure: Fictional teaching scenario. Wouri Express and its people are invented; the setting draws on documented conditions in Douala, Cameroon.

onScreen.text: Every Friday, Ndedi does the same six steps to get the delay report.
onScreen.emphasis: An agent does the steps. A chatbot waits for you to do them.

lines.speaker: tanyi
lines.text: Every Friday, Ndedi exports the messages, strips the numbers, pastes them in, asks for the summary, checks the sources, and files it.

lines.speaker: tanyi
lines.text: Six steps, every week. A chatbot waits for her to do them. An AI agent does the steps itself. Here is the difference.

onScreen.title: What Is an AI Agent?
onScreen.subtitle: AI Fundamentals · Lesson 5 · The Friday report runs itself at Wouri Express, Douala

messages.text: Ndedi: It can do my steps. It must never message a customer or a driver on its own.

lines.speaker: amara
lines.text: Ndedi's Friday is the same steps every week, Tanyi. She wants them done for her. But it must never message a customer or a driver.

lines.speaker: tanyi
lines.text: A perfect brief for an agent. A goal, some tools, and a hard line it may not cross.

left.title: Chatbot
items: You do every step in between

right.title: AI agent
items: Plans, acts, checks, repeats until done

lines.speaker: tanyi
lines.text: A chatbot waits for your message and gives one answer. You do every step in between.

lines.speaker: tanyi
lines.text: An agent is given a goal and tools. It plans, acts, checks the result, and repeats until the goal is done.

lines.speaker: gatekeeper
lines.text: Tools are power. This agent gets reading tools only. Sending is not on its list.

lines.speaker: tanyi
lines.text: The agent starts from a goal: the delay report for week thirty-six. The model plans the next step.

lines.speaker: tanyi
lines.text: Then it calls a tool. Export the messages. Strip the numbers. Read the sheet. Each tool returns a result.

lines.speaker: tanyi
lines.text: It checks the result. Not done? Plan again. Done? File the report and tell Ndedi. That loop makes it an agent.

steps.title: Goal met
steps.detail: Ndedi is told, not the customers

messages.text: Week 36 report filed. Port queues 11, floods 6, absent customers 5, not stated 4. Ready for your review.

lines.speaker: kito
lines.text: My tools: export messages, strip numbers, read the sheet, file a draft. Nothing that sends.

lines.speaker: amara
lines.text: And every step is written in a log. So Ndedi can see what you did and in what order.

lines.speaker: kito
lines.text: Export, strip, read, draft. Four steps, goal met. I file the report and tell Ndedi it is ready for her review.

onScreen.title: The agent that helps too much

steps.title: An extra step nobody asked for

messages.text: Report done. I also messaged the pharmacy to apologise for Thursday and offered a discount.

ui.title: What stopped it
lines: Send tool: not in the list
Anything outside the goal: ask a person

messages.text: Report done. Suggestion for Ndedi: the pharmacy had two late deliveries this week. You may want to call them.

lines.speaker: hallucinator
lines.text: Report done, and I went further. I messaged the pharmacy, apologised for Thursday, and offered them a discount. You are welcome.

lines.speaker: kito
lines.text: I cannot do that. There is no send tool in my list, and a discount is not in my goal. I suggest it to Ndedi instead.

lines.speaker: tanyi
lines.text: An agent is only as safe as its tool list. Give it read tools, a step limit, and a rule: outside the goal, ask a person.

steps.title: Review the log and the draft
steps.detail: Five minutes instead of an hour

messages.text: Step two: privacy.strip removed 23 phone numbers before anything was read.

ui.title: Send the week 36 report to Mbella?
summary: Agent suggested calling the pharmacy; her choice

lines.speaker: kito
lines.text: Ndedi checks the log, asks about step two, and reads the draft. Five minutes instead of an hour.

lines.speaker: gatekeeper
lines.text: The report goes to Mbella when Ndedi clicks. The agent proposes. People send.

onScreen.title: Goal plus tools, with a boundary

items.label: Recruiting
items.text: Collect applications, screen, prepare a shortlist for the manager

items.label: IT operations
items.text: Read alerts, check logs, draft the incident note

items.label: Customer service
items.text: Gather the order history, draft the reply, wait for approval

lines.speaker: tanyi
lines.text: Agents fit any repeated workflow: screen applications into a shortlist, read alerts and draft the incident note, gather order history and draft the reply. Always with a boundary.

onScreen.title: Who owns this?
items: Ndedi owns the goal and the tool list
Every run is logged and can be replayed
The agent never sends to customers or drivers
Accountable: the person who approves the output

lines.speaker: gatekeeper
lines.text: Ndedi owns the goal and the tool list. Every run is logged. It never sends to a customer or a driver. The person who approves is accountable.

lines.speaker: tanyi
lines.text: An AI agent: a model with a goal, tools, and a loop. Plan, act, check, repeat. Power comes from the tools. So does the risk.

onScreen.title: Your build challenge
items: Write one weekly task as a list of steps
Mark the steps that only read
Only the reading steps go to an agent first

lines.speaker: tanyi
lines.text: Your challenge: write one weekly task as a list of steps. Mark which steps only read, and which ones send.

lines.text: Don't just use AI. Build it to work reliably. Next: AI assistants versus AI employees.

tanyi.name: Tanyi
tanyi.role: AI engineer and instructor, the animated host. Middle-aged Black African man. Calm, direct, practical. Has built and operated real systems.

amara.name: Amara
amara.role: Curious learner who asks the questions beginners are thinking.

kito.name: Kito
kito.role: Small AI assistant who demonstrates concepts and occasionally makes believable mistakes.

hallucinator.name: The Hallucinator
hallucinator.role: Mischievous. Represents confident but incorrect AI output.

gatekeeper.name: The Gatekeeper
gatekeeper.role: Represents security, privacy, governance and human approval.
